seo.title: ChatSched — Intengiso Elawulwayo, Imarike & Umnatha Wabapapashi
seo.description: Xelela i-ChatSched injongo yakho, umphathi weephulo uzakwakhela yona — okanye ujonge kwaye ubhukishe abapapashi nabavelisi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokwakho — imidiya yentlalo, umphembeleli, iwebhusayithi, ipodcast nomsakazo.

hero.subtitle: I-ChatSched icwangcisa kwaye ilawule intengiso yakho kubapapashi, abavelisi kunye neendlela abaphulaphuli baseMzantsi Afrika abasele bebathemba — okanye ujonge imarike wenze konke ngokwakho. Ukhetho lwakho.

audienceSplit.heading: Nakuluphi na uhlangothi okulo, yenzelwe wena.
audienceSplit.businessTitle: Fikelela kubaphulaphuli abathenjwa ngabathengi bakho kakade
audienceSplit.businessBody: I-R199/inyanga ikunika ufikelelo kwimarike, iiphulo ezilawulwayo, kunye netyala lokuqala elingu-R199. Ukujonga kusimahla — ukuthumela isicelo kufuna ukubhalisa.
audienceSplit.publisherBody: I-R99/inyanga yofikelelo olupheleleyo kuMnatha Wabapapashi — vumela izicelo, misela ixabiso lakho, amathuba, imali efunyenweyo kunye nohlalutyo. Iprofayile esisiseko ihlala isimahla.

layers.title: Iindlela ezintathu zokungena, ipulatifomu enye ngasemva kwazo.
layers.subtitle: Ilawulelwe wena, uzenzele wena, okanye phakathi — khetha umgangatho ofanelekileyo indlela ofuna ukubandakanyeka ngayo.
layers.agencyBody: Xelela i-ChatSched injongo yakho, abaphulaphuli kunye nohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali. Umphathi wephulo uyayicwangcisa, abhukishe abapapashi abafanelekileyo, aze abuyisele ingxelo — uyavuma, thina senza konke okunye.
layers.marketplaceBody: Jonga, hlungela kwaye uthelekise abapapashi nabavelisi ngokwakho. Bhukisha ngokuthe ngqo, uhlawule kuphela xa iqinisekisiwe — akufuneki mphathi wephulo.
layers.networkBody: I-R99/inyanga inika umpapashi iprofayile eqinisekisiweyo, amathuba amaphulo, ibhodi yemali efunyenweyo kunye nohlalutyo — ipulatifomu epheleleyo yomvelisi, hayi nje uluhlu.

featured.title: Ezinye zamaphepha asele ekwibhodi.
featured.subtitle: Amaphepha nemibutho embalwa esele isebenza kwi-ChatSched — abanye bayajoyina rhoqo ngeveki.
featured.emptyDescription: Yongeza owokuqala kwipaneli yolawulo ukuzalisa oku.

channelsSection.title: Amanye amabhodi wokubeka ishishini lakho.
channelsSection.subtitle: Iindlela ezine ezintsha zokufikelela kubaphulaphuli baseMzantsi Afrika ngaphaya kwamaphepha entlalo — indlela efanayo ethe ngqo neyicace.

valueProp.body: Iiplatform zentengiso zentlalo zibhida ibhajethi yakho ngokuchasene nebhokisi emnyama zithembele ekubeni umntu ofanelekileyo aphuncuke ngexesha elifanelekileyo. I-ChatSched ikubeka ngqo phambi kwabaphulaphuli abasele bakhiwe ngumenzi wasekuhlaleni wokwenene — akukho ivenkile yentengiso, akukho algorithm, akukho ukuqikelela.

howItWorks.title: Nakuluphi na uhlangothi okulo, yindlela enye elula.
howItWorks.scene1Title: Fumana ibhodi yakho, okanye ubhalise iphepha lakho
howItWorks.scene2Title: Thumela isicelo, okanye ufumane esinye ukuze usihlolisise
howItWorks.scene3Title: Iyaqalisa ukusebenza — ufumana ubungqina, okanye ubonwe

payment.title: Imali igcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo de isibonakaliso siqale ukusebenza.
payment.step1: Ishishini liyacela, umvelisi uyavuma — okanye kuvalwe ngokuzenzekelayo emva kweentsuku ezi-{{days}} ngaphandle kwempendulo.
payment.step2: Ishishini lihlawula ngaphambili (ikhadi okanye i-EFT) — igcinwa apho de umvelisi apapashe aze ayenze ukuba isebenze.
payment.step3: Umvelisi uhlawulwa kwiiyure ezi-{{hours}} emva kokuqala ukusebenza — {{share}}% kumvelisi, intlawulo emiselweyo ye-{{commission}}% kwiplatform.
